answer: The cedar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ridge. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quill of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit.
